description: Maps an inbound JSON message onto a FHIR R4 Patient or Observation resource, strips unused fields, and pushes the clean resource downstream as JSON. The resource type and identifier system are configurable; with no configuration it builds a Patient, unchanged from earlier versions.

config.label: Resource Type
config.description: Which FHIR resource to build from the inbound fields.

config.label: Identifier System
config.description: The identifier system to stamp on a Patient's identifier when the input carries an identifier_value but no identifier_system of its own. An identifier_system in the input overrides this. Not used for Observation.

config.label: On Error
config.description: What to do when the input cannot be mapped. 'Stop' logs the error and forwards nothing - a partial or malformed resource is never sent. 'Push to error route' forwards the original input to the Error Topic instead.

config.label: Error Topic
config.description: Topic to publish the original input to when On Error is 'Push to error route'. Leave empty when On Error is 'Stop'.
